items: Simplicity (saadgi): Generate and Test algorithm samajhna aur banana (implement karna) aasan hai, is liye saade maslon ke liye faidemand hai.
Versatility (har jagah kaam aana): yeh bohat se maslon par lagaya ja sakta hai, khaas taur par jab hal ki koi saaf strategy na ho.
Exhaustiveness (mukammal talash): algorithm tamam mumkin hal dekhta hai, is liye koi mumkin hal nazar-andaz nahi hota.
Inefficiency (efficient na hona): bare problem space mein yeh bohat sust ho sakta hai, kyun ke valid hal milne se pehle bohat se hal test karne par sakte hain.

No Optimality Guarantee (behtareen hal ki pakki guarantee nahi): yeh zaroori nahi ke sab se behtar (optimal) hal dhoonde; sirf valid hal ki guarantee (pakka wada) deta hai. Maslan optimization problems mein aisa hal mil sakta hai jo chal jaye magar sab se behtar na ho.

Computational Expense (computer ka zyada kharcha: waqt aur memory): jin maslon ke mumkin hal bohat zyada hon, un mein yeh algorithm bohat mehnga (zyada waqt aur memory) aur practically na-mumkin ho sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne “Pros and Cones” aur “Cones” chhapa hai. Sahi lafz “Cons” hai, yani nuqsan (disadvantages). “Cones” ka yahan koi matlab nahi.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Generate and Test algorithm aksar AI applications mein istemal hota hai, jaise games khelna aur masle hal karna, jahan solution space bara hota hai aur behtareen tareeqa yahi hota hai ke alag alag possibilities aazmaye jayein jab tak koi chal jaye!

blocks.alt: Teen dabbe: oopar GENERATOR, beech mein TESTER aur neeche daen STOP. Possible Solution wala teer GENERATOR se TESTER tak; Correct Solution wala teer TESTER se STOP tak; Incorrect Solution wali lakeer TESTER se nikal kar wapas GENERATOR mein jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2: Generate and Test algorithm ke process ka flowchart (kitab ki Figure 3.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: GENERATOR ek mumkin hal (possible solution) banata hai aur TESTER use jaanchta hai. Hal sahi (correct) ho to process STOP par ruk jata hai; ghalat (incorrect) ho to baen wali lakeer wapas GENERATOR tak jati hai aur naya hal banta hai. Yeh chakkar tab tak chalta hai jab tak sahi hal na mil jaye.

blocks.prompt: Generate and Test sab se behtar hal kyun chhor sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh pehle us hal par ruk jata hai jo test paas kare; woh hal sahi (valid) to hai magar zaroori nahi ke sab se behtar (optimal) ho.

items: Pros: saada, har jagah kaam aane wala, mukammal talash.
Cons: bare maslon mein sust, behtareen hal ki guarantee nahi, zyada computational kharcha.
